frame.origin: centre of the tunnel turntable on the floor plane (ground surface there at z = 33.07 m)
frame.y: +y WEST (compass rose of MP_caseM.png: N at +x, W at +y); the frame is right-handed
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR; the campus ground lies at z ~ 32 m
frame.wind_direction_rotation: meteorological FROM-direction: 180° blows toward +x; flow_dir = (-cos WD, +sin WD), so a larger WD turns the plume toward -y. Measured on the tunnel's 175 / 180 / 185° and on the 18 field runs.

files.format: ASCII STL, LF line endings, outward normals
files.source: BD_caseM.stl (terrain + buildings) scaled x600 from model to full-scale metres; 3118 of 3152 horizontal facets faced down as published, so every triangle is reversed to point outward; one shell with 21 boundary and 7 non-manifold edges
files.render_caption: TPU Atsugi campus: terrain and buildings of the 1:600 model (full-scale metres, 1080 m by 720 m); the arrow is the wind at WD = 180°, blowing toward +x (north).
